_comment: Catalyst template — standalone FastDL (fast download) web server for HL1/Source engine games, built on the Caddy static file server. Hand-maintained Catalyst egg (PTDL_v2 format, importable by Pterodactyl-style panels).
name: FastDL (Caddy) - HL1/Source Content Server
author: catalyst
description:
Standalone FastDL (fast download) web server for Half-Life 1 and Source engine games. Serves client download content (maps, models, sounds, materials) from ./fastdl/<gamedir>/ with byte-Range support, 304 revalidation, correct MIME types and a browsable directory index — the HTTP features engines need to download custom content at line speed. Works with Counter-Strike 1.6, Garry's Mod, CS:S, TF2, HL2:DM, Sven Co-op and any game supporting sv_downloadurl.

Upload content via SFTP into ./fastdl/<gamedir>/ (e.g. fastdl/cstrike/ or fastdl/garrysmod/), then set on each game server: sv_downloadurl "http://<node-ip>:<this-port>".

The runtime is a single static Caddy binary on a minimal Alpine image — no database, no scripting, ~64 MB RAM. HL1/Source FastDL is plain HTTP; put a reverse proxy or CDN in front for HTTPS (it must pass Range requests through).

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# FastDL (Caddy) install script — Catalyst template
# Downloads the Caddy static binary and creates the FastDL docroot.
# Server files: /mnt/server (symlinked to /data by the Catalyst install wrapper)

set -o pipefail

CADDY_VERSION="${FD_CADDY_VERSION:-2.11.4}"

# Resolve 'latest' to a concrete version via the GitHub API.
if [ "${CADDY_VERSION}" = "latest" ]; then
    CADDY_VERSION="$(curl -fsSL https://api.github.com/repos/caddyserver/caddy/releases/latest | grep -m1 -oE '"tag_name": *"v[0-9.]+"' | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+')"
    if [ -z "${CADDY_VERSION}" ]; then
        echo "Could not resolve 'latest' Caddy version, falling back to 2.11.4"
        CADDY_VERSION="2.11.4"
    fi
fi

# Map machine architecture to the Caddy release artifact.
ARCH="$(uname -m)"
case "${ARCH}" in
    x86_64)        CADDY_ARCH="amd64" ;;
    aarch64|arm64) CADDY_ARCH="arm64" ;;
    armv7l)        CADDY_ARCH="armv7" ;;
    *) echo "Unsupported architecture: ${ARCH}"; exit 1 ;;
esac

echo "Installing Caddy v${CADDY_VERSION} for linux/${CADDY_ARCH}..."

mkdir -p /mnt/server/fastdl/cstrike /mnt/server/fastdl/garrysmod
cd /mnt/server || exit 1

curl -fSL --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 -o /tmp/caddy.tar.gz \
    "https://github.com/caddyserver/caddy/releases/download/v${CADDY_VERSION}/caddy_${CADDY_VERSION}_linux_${CADDY_ARCH}.tar.gz" \
    || { echo "ERROR: failed to download Caddy v${CADDY_VERSION}"; exit 1; }

# Verify the tarball against the published checksums (skipped if checksums.txt is unavailable).
curl -fsSL -o /tmp/caddy-checksums.txt \
    "https://github.com/caddyserver/caddy/releases/download/v${CADDY_VERSION}/caddy_${CADDY_VERSION}_checksums.txt" || true
EXPECTED_SHA="$(awk -v f="caddy_${CADDY_VERSION}_linux_${CADDY_ARCH}.tar.gz" '$2==f {print $1}' /tmp/caddy-checksums.txt 2>/dev/null)"
if [ -n "${EXPECTED_SHA}" ]; then
    ACTUAL_SHA="$(sha512sum /tmp/caddy.tar.gz | awk '{print $1}')"
    if [ "${EXPECTED_SHA}" != "${ACTUAL_SHA}" ]; then
        echo "ERROR: checksum mismatch for the Caddy tarball"
        echo "  expected: ${EXPECTED_SHA}"
        echo "  actual:   ${ACTUAL_SHA}"
        exit 1
    fi
    echo "SHA-512 checksum verified."
fi

# Extract only the static binary — it runs on both the Debian install image
# (glibc) and the Alpine runtime image (musl) because it has no dynamic deps.
mkdir -p /tmp/caddy-install
tar -xzf /tmp/caddy.tar.gz -C /tmp/caddy-install caddy
mv -f /tmp/caddy-install/caddy /mnt/server/caddy
chmod +x /mnt/server/caddy
rm -rf /tmp/caddy-install /tmp/caddy.tar.gz /tmp/caddy-checksums.txt

# Sanity check: the binary must execute in the install container.
if ! /mnt/server/caddy version > /dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "ERROR: Caddy binary failed to execute"
    exit 1
fi
echo "Installed $(/mnt/server/caddy version)"

# Seed the docroot with a README describing the expected layout.
cat > /mnt/server/fastdl/README.txt <<'EOF'
FastDL docroot — served at http://<server-ip>:<server-port>/

Place downloadable game content in a folder named after the game's
mod directory, mirroring the game server's own directory layout:

  fastdl/cstrike/maps/de_dust2.bsp         <- CS 1.6 (clients fetch cstrike/maps/...)
  fastdl/garrysmod/maps/rp_downtown.bsp    <- Garry's Mod
  fastdl/tf2/maps/..., fastdl/css/maps/... <- any other HL1/Source game

Optional: pre-compress large files as .bz2 next to the originals
(map.bsp + map.bsp.bz2). HL1 engines fetch the .bz2 automatically and
clients decompress locally, saving most of the bandwidth.

On each game server, set:
  sv_downloadurl "http://<this-server-ip>:<this-server-port>"
then changelevel (or restart the map) for it to take effect.
EOF

echo "FastDL install complete."

variables.name: Caddy Version
variables.description: Caddy release to install (e.g. 2.11.4), or 'latest' to resolve the newest release at install time. Change the value and reinstall the server to upgrade.

variables.name: Max Connections
variables.description: Concurrent client download connections accepted before refusing new ones. 0 = unlimited (the internal file cache auto-scales). Recommended: roughly 3x the number of simultaneous downloads you expect.
